title: Do not spend a passing body on a burdened tongue
summary: The shabad holds life beside a stage-play and shows how greed, falsehood, and gossip load the soul with weight. A passing body is too precious to spend carrying a dirty tongue.
takeaway: Do not spend a passing body on a burdened tongue.
lifeApplication: Before joining a side conversation today, remember how quickly the scene changes and choose one sentence that lightens rather than loads the heart.

source.shortMeaning: Life passes like a stage-play, yet greed and falsehood make the soul carry unnecessary weight.
source.lifeApplication: When gossip feels harmless, let the shortness of this life make the mouth careful.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad pairs the body’s fragile comfort with the heavy burden created by greed, falsehood, and gossip.
evidence.turn: Let mortality interrupt speech before the tongue chooses another burden.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before joining a side conversation today, remember how quickly the scene changes and choose one sentence that lightens rather than loads the heart.
